projects.title: Automated Ticket Buying Desktop App
projects.full_description:
I’m seeking an experienced developer to complete an existing automated ticket-buying bot with a Windows desktop dashboard for Ticketmaster and SeatGeek.

The main deliverable is a working purchasing engine that automatically monitors ticket availability, identifies tickets matching my criteria, reserves them, and completes checkout using assigned accounts and supported saved payment methods. The dashboard must let me configure and monitor this automation without editing code.

Source files, executables, screenshots, and an improved dashboard with simulated workflows are available. The existing simulation does not fulfill the automatic purchasing requirement.

Automatic Purchasing Requirements
Once I configure and start a task, the bot should automatically:
1. Open the specified event using the assigned account sessions.
2. Handle supported queue workflows and begin monitoring when access becomes available.
3. Identify inventory matching my section, row, ticket-type, quantity, seating, and price requirements.
4. Reserve qualifying tickets.
5. Verify the selected tickets, final quantity, and total price, including applicable fees and taxes.
6. Complete checkout through a supported, authorized integration using the assigned purchasing profile and payment method.
7. Verify the order outcome and record the confirmation details.
8. Notify me of successful purchases, failures, or required intervention.
9. Stop when the shared ticket target or spending limit is reached.

Provide two selectable operating modes:
- Automatic Purchase: Starting the task authorizes purchases within its configured event, ticket criteria, quantity, and spending limits. No additional approval is required for each qualifying purchase.
- Approval Required: Reserve qualifying tickets and request approval locally or through Discord before completing checkout.
Any authentication, verification, or payment step that requires human involvement must be clearly identified before development. The bot must pause and notify me when intervention is required.

Multiple Accounts and Purchase Controls
A single task must support multiple accounts and individual purchasing profiles, with an initial configuration target of 50 accounts. This will be more.

Coordinate activity across accounts so the bot does not purchase duplicate inventory or exceed shared limits. An individual account failure should not stop other eligible accounts.

After a timeout or uncertain checkout response, verify whether an order succeeded before retrying. Once the task target is reached, stop outstanding purchase attempts safely.
Required Live Demonstration

Demonstrate the complete automatic workflow separately on each supported platform: matching inventory, reservation, final-price validation, checkout submission, and verified order confirmation.

Use an agreed test environment or an explicitly authorized live purchase with a fixed spending limit. 

Clearly identify unsupported features and unavoidable manual steps. A simulation, cart-only demonstration, or checkout link does not satisfy the automatic purchasing requirement.

Deliver and demonstrate the agreed live purchasing workflow on Ticketmaster and SeatGeek, including automatic checkout, verified order outcomes, coordinated account activity, enforced quantity/spending limits, duplicate prevention, and notifications. Acceptance requires evidence of the agreed end-to-end functionality on each platform.

projects.title: CSGO Case Opening Web Development
projects.full_description:
I’m looking to build a modern crypto-based case opening website similar in concept to [login to view URL], but with its own branding, design, user experience, and backend system.

The platform should allow users to create an account, deposit supported cryptocurrencies, maintain a balance on the website, open virtual cases, receive rewards based on published probabilities, manage their winnings or inventory, and withdraw eligible balances or rewards through cryptocurrency.

The main goal is to create a premium, fast, trustworthy, and highly interactive platform that works smoothly on both desktop and mobile.

Main functionality should include:

• User registration and login
• User dashboard
• Cryptocurrency deposits
• Cryptocurrency withdrawals
• Internal wallet/balance system
• Case opening system
• Item/reward inventory
• Item trading or selling system
• Transaction history
• Case opening history
• Provably fair verification
• Promotions and bonuses
• Notifications
• Admin dashboard
• Security and fraud monitoring
• KYC/AML and compliance tools where required

USER SYSTEM

Users should be able to create accounts using email/password and potentially social login options.

Each user should have a dashboard showing:

• Current balance
• Crypto deposits
• Withdrawals
• Recent case openings
• Rewards won
• Inventory
• Transaction history
• Account verification status
• Security settings
• Bonuses/promotions

Users should also have options for email verification, two-factor authentication, password changes, active session management, and withdrawal security.

CRYPTO DEPOSITS

The website should support cryptocurrency deposits through a secure crypto payment provider or wallet infrastructure.

Users should be able to select a supported cryptocurrency and receive a deposit address or payment session.

The system should automatically monitor incoming transactions and credit the user's account once the required blockchain confirmations are completed.

Deposit information should include:

• Cryptocurrency
• Amount
• USD equivalent
• Wallet address
• Transaction hash
• Network
• Confirmation status
• Date/time
• Deposit status

The system must prevent duplicate credits and protect against manipulated payment callbacks.

CRYPTO WITHDRAWALS

Users should be able to withdraw eligible balances using supported cryptocurrencies.

The withdrawal flow should allow the user to:

1. Select cryptocurrency
2. Enter wallet address
3. Enter withdrawal amount
4. View network fee
5. Confirm withdrawal
6. Complete security verification
7. Track withdrawal status

Withdrawal statuses should include:

Pending
Under Review
Approved
Processing
Completed
Rejected
Failed

Admins should be able to configure minimum withdrawals, maximum withdrawals, fees, daily limits, and supported networks.

CASE OPENING SYSTEM

The main feature will be the case opening experience.

Users should be able to browse different cases with different prices and possible rewards.

Case categories could include:

• Starter Cases
• Standard Cases
• Premium Cases
• High Roller Cases
• Limited Edition Cases
• Promotional Cases
• Featured Cases

Every case should have its own page showing:

• Case image
• Case name
• Opening price
• Possible rewards
• Reward values
• Rarity
• Probability percentage for every reward
• Number of openings
• Terms or restrictions

The user clicks "Open Case," the backend securely determines the result, and then an animated case-opening sequence displays the winning item.

The animation should not determine the result. The result should be generated securely by the backend first.

The case animation should be high quality and include smooth scrolling, sound effects, rarity effects, celebration effects for valuable rewards, and responsive animations.

PROVABLY FAIR SYSTEM

I want the platform to have a provably fair system so users can independently verify that case outcomes were not manipulated.

The system should use a professionally implemented server seed, client seed, nonce, hash, or similar cryptographic mechanism.

There should be a dedicated Provably Fair page explaining how results are calculated and allowing users to verify previous case openings.

INVENTORY SYSTEM

Rewards won from cases should appear inside the user's inventory.

Users should be able to:

• View items
• View item value
• View rarity
• View case source
• View date won
• Sell eligible items for site balance
• Trade items where supported
• Withdraw eligible rewards if applicable

The inventory should support sorting and filtering by value, rarity, category, and date.

LIVE ACTIVITY

The website should include real-time activity where appropriate.

Examples:

• Recent case openings
• Recent large wins
• Live balance updates
• Deposit confirmations
• Withdrawal updates
• User notifications

ADMIN DASHBOARD

The platform needs a complete admin panel where authorized staff can operate the website without modifying code.

Admin functionality should include:

USER MANAGEMENT

• Search users
• View profiles
• View verification status
• Suspend accounts
• Restrict withdrawals
• Review activity
• Review deposits
• Review withdrawals
• View case history
• View security events

CASE MANAGEMENT

Admins should be able to:

• Create cases
• Edit cases
• Upload case images
• Set case price
• Add rewards
• Set reward values
• Configure probabilities
• Enable/disable cases
• Schedule cases
• Create limited-time cases
• Organize categories

Every important case or probability change should be recorded in an audit log.

TRANSACTION MANAGEMENT

Admins should be able to view:

• Deposits
• Withdrawals
• Internal balance transactions
• Item sales
• Bonuses
• Manual adjustments
• Payment failures

Every financial action should have a permanent transaction record.

Balances should not simply be overwritten manually. The system should use a ledger-based accounting structure showing exactly why every balance change happened.

WITHDRAWAL MANAGEMENT

Admins should be able to review suspicious or high-value withdrawals before approval.

The system should include risk indicators such as:

• New account
• Recently changed password
• Recently changed email
• New withdrawal wallet
• Unusual IP address
• Multiple accounts
• Abnormal deposit/withdrawal activity
• Large withdrawal
• KYC status

SECURITY

Security is extremely important because the platform handles cryptocurrency and user balances.

The system should include:

• Secure password hashing
• HTTPS
• Two-factor authentication
• Rate limiting
• CSRF protection
• XSS protection
• SQL injection protection
• Secure sessions
• API authentication
• Withdrawal confirmation
• Admin 2FA
• Login monitoring
• Audit logs
• Fraud detection
• Suspicious activity monitoring

Sensitive administrative actions should require elevated permissions.

ADMIN PERMISSIONS

There should be multiple admin roles.

For example:

Owner
Administrator
Finance Manager
Compliance Manager
Support Agent

A support employee should not have permission to modify case odds, user balances, or cryptocurrency configuration.

DESIGN

The website should have a premium dark gaming-style interface.

The design should feel modern and professional rather than looking like a generic gambling template.

Possible design direction:

• Dark background
• Strong accent colors
• Premium case artwork
• Smooth gradients
• High-quality typography
• Animated buttons
• Hover effects
• Reward rarity colors
• Clean navigation
• Responsive mobile interface

The mobile version should be specifically optimized instead of simply shrinking the desktop website.

PAGES

The platform should include:

Home
Cases
Individual Case Page
Inventory
Deposit
Withdraw
Transactions
Case History
Provably Fair
Promotions
Dashboard
Account Settings
Security Settings
FAQ
Support
Responsible Gaming
Terms of Service
Privacy Policy
AML/KYC Information
Restricted Countries

COMPLIANCE

Because this platform combines cryptocurrency with chance-based case openings, compliance needs to be considered before production launch.

The system should be capable of supporting:

• Age verification
• KYC verification
• AML monitoring
• Geographic restrictions
• Restricted jurisdictions
• Deposit limits
• Withdrawal limits
• Responsible gaming controls
• Cooling-off periods
• Self-exclusion
• Account suspension
• Transaction monitoring

The exact licensing and compliance requirements will depend on where the platform is incorporated and where users are allowed to access it.

TECHNICAL REQUIREMENTS

I am not looking for only a frontend demonstration.

The final platform should eventually include:

• Production frontend
• Backend/API
• Database
• Crypto payment integration
• Wallet/accounting system
• Case engine
• Provably fair system
• Inventory system
• Admin panel
• User dashboard
• Notifications
• Security system
• Compliance tools
• Logging and monitoring
• Deployment configuration

The database should properly separate users, wallets, deposits, withdrawals, transactions, cases, rewards, probabilities, case openings, inventory, promotions, verification records, security events, and administrator actions.

The architecture should also be scalable so the platform can support increasing numbers of users and transactions.

Before production launch, the platform should be thoroughly tested for:

• Deposits
• Withdrawals
• Balance calculations
• Case probabilities
• Provably fair verification
• User authentication
• Admin permissions
• Security vulnerabilities
• Payment callbacks
• Mobile functionality
• Performance
• Load handling

The goal is to build a complete, professional case-opening platform inspired by established websites such as [login to view URL] while creating an original brand, interface, backend, and overall user experience.

We are looking for energetic and confident **Calling Partners / Telecallers to help us connect with business owners who may need a professional website.

### What You’ll Do

* Call business owners from the lead lists we provide.
* Introduce our website development services.
* Find out whether they already have a website or are interested in getting one.
* Identify interested clients and connect them with our team.
* Follow up with interested business owners when required.

You do not need to handle technical work, website development, pricing discussions, or delivery. Our team will take care of those parts.

### Commission

This is a pure commission-based opportunity** with no fixed salary.

You receive 30% commission on every client you successfully convert**.

For example:

₹50,000 project → ₹15,000 commission
$1,000 project → $300 commission

The more clients you convert, the more you earn. There is **no fixed earning limit**.

No registration fee, security deposit, subscription fee, or payment is required to start.

### What We Provide

* Filtered business leads with contact details
* Basic information about each business
* Guidance on how to approach the businesses
* Website demos/examples when needed
* Full support from our team for interested clients

We are especially interested in people who are comfortable speaking professionally with business owners directly.

You can use the calling method/number available to you. International callers should have their own suitable calling or VoIP setup.

If you are confident in communication and interested in earning through successful client conversions, apply with your preferred calling language(s) and a short voice/conversation sample if possible.

projects.title: Excel Time-Material Invoice and Payroll Builder
projects.full_description:
I already track every hour worked and every material purchase via field tech daily sheets that my techs fill out each day. I want to then put the info into excel. i copy the daily sheets and turn them into the client when I invoice. I have been hand writing them because I had not had a computer at the job. I brought one of my old computers... window 7 outlook 2013 to the job. I’m semi-retired just doing the job for a few months because it’s an old client I have enjoyed working for over the years. I just built a simple excel sheet to track the techs hours, and trip charges and expenses. In doing that I have realized how much I have forgotten. I would like to use drop down menus to populate fields and v lookup/or better to populate invoices to the client with the techs info I choose with the company costs for the job. I can then add the company’s daily costs and summaries as need. It is a time and materials job. No bidding. In an Excel 2013 worksheet I need that same file to generate a clean, print-ready invoice sheet—still in Excel—without having to re-enter any data unless I choose to change some of it. 

I have a summery accounting sheet –which is a summary of the daily accounting sheets I turn in ith the summary accounting sheet- this acts as my invoice..
 The daily accounting sheets are made from the field tech daily summary that is turned in from techs each day listing their personal expenses, 906 expenses I can charge for (like purchases and or Truck stock used and a scope of work summary. I ad 906 company expense to this.
I turn in the FT daily summary sheets as well with my paperwork. 

NOTES- I invoice for 5 to 15 days at a time. It totals up each line. Then I may give a discount. The client can read the daily sheets for details or review the ft daily summary the each turn in for details.
I may fill in some of the scope of work completed but I always don’t have time to… since I'm working in the field and don’t have office staff…

Some details…
The daily accounting sheets include. 
At the top there is a date field and a day field and the total for costs and labor.
Costs include trip charges$ costs for trucks of my fields if I choose to pay them (generally when they have to drive over 45 min I get them trip charges… also daily I charge $85 for truck 1 Company box truck foul of tools as long we work and I'm not just doing paperwork. if I use my other truck for towing, material pick up, and so forth, I charge them $45 for truck 2….
Next expenses are totaled and 15 % added- expense are truck stock used – I will enter a number I feel is close to the truck used for the day.
Purchases – list purchases the company makes and some description of some the items and the costs for each purchase. List techs expenses as a purchases sometimes I need to reimburse them sometimes I don’t because use my card or other reason
Equipment – I charge a set fee for my dump trailer or other trailers. Tractor ½ day or full day, also if implements for my tractor. For other equipment I need to charge for I just come up with a rate

Labor Column lists tech 1 then the hours they worked – then their rate – then the total for that tech for the day. The techs names are not listed it is a generic Tech 1 Tech 2 and so on.


What I need from you: 
• Link the excel I’ve started to make- tracking the techs hour and costs from the techs daily summary 
 to track and create payroll to the techs for a set amount of days they work
 create daily sheets in a format similar to the sheets the clients have already been receiving
• I'm to import the techs labor and expenses as well as add the company expenses to these costs.
 And then a summery accounting sheet totaling up the days I'm invoicing for
 and able to add a discount if I choose
• this sheet continuously builds and I don’t have to make a new each invoice
o I just can put in a range and add info as need to create payroll and invoices for the dates needed. And I get a report for each that can be used as an invoice and a payroll….
o These reports can be “Saved as a PDF” if I ever need it or printed.
 on the daily accounting sheets the client gets the details- client details, job description, an itemized list of time and materials, as I see fit, separate truck/trip charges and the 15 % upcharge for expenses. 
o Include formulas (or a simple macro, if easier) that keep subtotals and grand totals accurate even when I add or delete rows in the source sheet. 
o All numbers are rounded up.

• I hoping When you’re done I should be able to open the workbook, type in the latest hours and purchases on the tracking sheet, add the companies daily details and print—or email—the finished invoice or make a payroll instantly. 
• A brief note explaining any formulas or code you add will be plenty for me to maintain it later.
Thanks for taking the time to decipher my grammar and elementary style of requirements. I didn’t have AI clean it up or write so they would completely take us off course and make it sound better while taking us off course- ! 
 
I'm sure there will some back and forth … so the please include some extra time to get this right.

projects.title: Green Day Tribute Show
projects.full_description:
I’m booking an indoor concert-style event and I want the crowd to feel as if Billie Joe and the gang just walked on stage. I need a seasoned Green Day tribute performer (solo or full band) who can deliver a tight, energetic one-hour set packed with the classics—think “Basket Case,” “American Idiot,” and the deeper fan favorites that keep everyone singing along.

What you’ll bring 
• Authentic Green Day sound and stage presence for a full 60-minute performance 
• Your own instruments and any specialty gear you rely on; the venue supplies a standard PA and lighting rig 
• A concise set list and basic technical rider at least one week before the show so our in-house engineer can prep

What I’ll provide 
• Indoor venue with professional sound, monitors, and dedicated sound tech 
• A 30-minute sound-check window on the day of the show 
• Backstage green room and drink tickets

Acceptance criteria 
1. Performance lasts a minimum of 55 and a maximum of 65 minutes. 
2. Clear, audible vocals and instruments throughout—no feedback issues or prolonged dead air. 
3. Audience engagement matches the high-energy feel of a Green Day concert.

If you’ve wowed festival or club audiences before and have video proof or live recordings, share the links when you bid. Let’s make this a night of pure punk-rock nostalgia.

projects.title: Create 4-Hour Video Loop
projects.full_description:
I have a finished clip that already includes its soundtrack; it’s anround 20 secs all that’s missing is a clean, extended export. Your task is to take my original file and repeat it until the runtime reaches a full four hours. 

Small, natural gaps between repetitions are fine—I don’t need a perfectly seamless transition—but there must be absolutely no freezes, black frames, or audio glitches. 

Deliverables 
• One high-quality export totalling 4:00:00 (same resolution and codec as the source) 
• Audio level preserved exactly as in the original 
• File returned via a share link or direct upload, ready for immediate use on YouTube and digital signage 

That’s it—simple, fast, and precise.
